messages:
dan: Heads-up  procurement looped me on a proposal from BillFold.ai for automated invoice ingestion + GL mapping. Pricing looks unusual, want quick sanity check.
nina: Share the excerpt? curious about any per-field charges.
dan: pasted vendor snippet: 
```
BillFold.ai pricing (enterprise): $0.09 per invoice + $0.003 per extracted field; attachments billed $0.01/page. Minimum annual commit: $25k. Includes API, SSO. Onboarding PS estimated 40 hours.
POC: 30 days free sandbox, then metered.
```
otto: Ugh field-based pricing again. For our volume (est. 1.1M/yr) that can be unpredictable.
finance-ops: Important constraints: 1) must produce line-item-level output with tax/discount breakdowns 2) need programmatic export (S3 push + webhook) 3) audit log retained 7 years 4) must accept DPA + KMS controls.
dan: Procurement asked: a) can they ingest our BigQuery export (we can share schema) b) do they count line items as fields or as nested records? c) sample cost breakdown at our volume d) SLA on processing latency and error rate e) rollback / versioning for mapping rules.
nina: Suggest adding: ask for a breakdown of PS vs product work. Also whether per-page charges apply to compressed multipage PDFs or only uncompressed pages.
otto: Negotiation levers: request flat per-invoice cap beyond threshold (e.g., cap per invoice cost to $0.05 after 100k/mo), include X hours PS in year 1, and ask to waive per-page fee for attachments ingested via our OCR preprocessor.
finance-ops: Also ask: do you expose reconciliation deltas (matched/unmatched) per webhook event? We need to alert when unmatched rate > 1%.
dan: Draft vendor questions I'm about to send 
- Can you ingest our BigQuery export and GCS attachments? Any schema gaps?
- Do you price by invoice only or by extracted field/line item? How do you treat nested line items?
- Provide sample invoice showing monthly costs at 50k / 150k / 300k invoice tiers for a 12/24 month term.
- Is SSO (SAML + SCIM) and SCIM provisioning included?
- Can GL mappings and rules be exported (YAML/JSON) and stored in our repo?
- What onboarding PS hours are typical and what is included vs billable?
- What SLA do you provide for daily/critical processing windows and error rates? Please share sample contract language.
- Do you support KMS/HSM key control and sign our DPA?
- Do you offer a 30-day escape clause in year 1 if accuracy < agreed benchmark after onboarding?
- Will you provide audit logs suitable for forward to our SIEM (Splunk) and an S3 dump of reconciled payloads?
procurement-bot: Reminder: attach RFP + sample BigQuery export when replying. Use /procure/reply-template-v4.
nina: Minor edit: add "How do you handle FX adjustments and credit notes?"
dan: Good call. Adding that. Sending now and will paste replies here. If they push field pricing hard, we should ask for a fixed cap or move to per-invoice with line-item guarantee.
otto: If vendor refuses to provide rule export, it's a blocker for us. We need versionable mapping rules.
finance-ops: Also call out retention for audit logs (7y) and a requirement that any subcontractor handling data must be disclosed.
dan: Thanks team 
 will loop replies back here.
